# Template Documentation

This folder contains **“what to change”** guides for teams cloning this repo as a starting point.

- Prefer `docs/engineering/` for core architecture/patterns that apply across features.
- Prefer `docs/template/` for docs that explain how to customize this template for a product (domains, deep links, flavors, etc.).

## Recommended pairing

Use this mobile template with
[backend-core-kit](https://github.com/fikrilal/backend-core-kit). Their API,
auth, session, and user contracts are designed to work together, so new
products can focus on their main features instead of rebuilding the foundation.

Start with `first_use_checklist.md`, then read
`networking_backend_contract.md` when connecting the backend.
